hero-vendimia.papel: Héroe principal con espacio negativo para el titular a 375 y 1366 px.
hero-vendimia.prompt: Fotografía editorial documental panorámica de un camping rural mediano entre viñedos viejos al amanecer de vendimia. Una calle compacta de tierra calcárea atraviesa hileras bajas de cepas maduras y muros secos; dos parcelas ordenadas con caravanas completamente genéricas quedan separadas del cultivo por ribazos. Al fondo, una recepción pequeña encalada con tejado de teja. Luz dorada baja, polvo blanco contenido y mucho espacio negativo a la derecha para titular. Ninguna persona, rostro, texto, señal legible, matrícula, botella, copa, marca de vino, piscina, resort, castillo, HDR ni saturación.

hero-patio.papel: Héroe secundario y página no encontrada.

Tras el patio se perciben cepas y bancales, no un complejo turístico. Composición amplia con espacio negativo. Ninguna persona, rostro, texto, rótulo, marca, botella, copa, barrica decorativa, fiesta, guirnalda, piscina, resort ni HDR.

vida-llegada.papel: Llegada de dos amigos durante la vendimia sin invadir el cultivo.
vida-llegada.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: human editorial scene for the Camping Entre Vinyes demo website
Primary request: Photoreal editorial documentary photograph of two adult friends aged roughly 28–40 finishing a calm arrival at a Cepa pitch during harvest season in the same modest Mediterranean vineyard campsite.
Input images: tipo-parcela-cepa.webp is the exact pale limestone gravel, low stone vineyard boundary, young shade tree, compact generic silver camper, plain awning, table and protected utility point reference.
Scene/backdrop: One clearly bounded pitch beside old vines; the vineyard, utility point and entire access lane remain untouched and clear.
Subject: One guest carries exactly one plain soft travel bag from the blank side door of the camper while the other places exactly two folded canvas chairs together beneath the existing awning; both focus on the task and neither enters the vineyard.
Style/medium: Natural editorial documentary photography, 35 mm lens, restrained limestone, dusty olive, faded blue-grey and muted garnacha palette, subtle film grain.
Composition/framing: Horizontal 3:2, pitch geometry, boundary and working landscape dominate; people occupy 14–24 percent and remain in the central 70 percent for mobile crop.
Lighting/mood: Low September morning light, practical and unhurried rather than romantic.
Constraints: Both guests, bag and chairs remain fully inside the pitch with a clear empty gravel strip before the lane and stone boundary; plausible hands and chair joints; anonymous side/back views; camper side is completely blank with no badge, characters, number or licence plate; no object touches the vine, tree or utility point.
Avoid: grape picking, guest in cultivated soil, crate of grapes, wine bottle, glass, barrel, cable across lane, rug, campfire, readable text, logos, frontal smiles, extra fingers, luxury advertising, HDR, watermark.
